status: PROPOSED — awaiting Phase 0 gate and Engineering Lead / Domain Reviewer sign-off
description: Deterministic validator catalogue. Runs independently of the model (Charter/Task Protocol requirement) — see supabase/functions/_shared/validation/*.ts. Generated by scripts/export-specs.ts.

validators.title: Invoice number format
validators.description: invoice_number matches a plausible identifier pattern (alphanumeric plus -/_. separators, 2–40 chars).

validators.title: Date format
validators.description: Fields ending in _date are valid ISO-8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and real calendar dates.

validators.title: Currency code format
validators.description: currency matches the ISO-4217 shape: exactly 3 uppercase letters.

validators.title: Incoterm code format
validators.description: incoterm matches the Incoterms shape: exactly 3 uppercase letters.

validators.title: Line item arithmetic
validators.description: quantity × unit_price = line_total, within one minor currency unit.

validators.title: Subtotal arithmetic
validators.description: Sum of line_items[*].line_total = subtotal, within one minor currency unit.

validators.title: Grand total arithmetic
validators.description: subtotal − discount + tax + freight + insurance = grand_total, within one minor currency unit.

validators.title: IBAN checksum
validators.description: bank_iban passes the ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 checksum.

validators.title: VAT ID structure
validators.description: seller_vat_id has a plausible VAT-ID shape (country prefix + alphanumeric). Structural only — no country-specific checksum.

validators.title: Currency reference lookup
validators.description: currency is present in the curated currency subset.

validators.title: Incoterms 2020 lookup
validators.description: incoterm is one of the 11 official Incoterms 2020 rules.

validators.title: Country reference lookup
validators.description: country_of_origin is present in the curated country-code subset.

validators.title: Invoice date not in the future
validators.description: invoice_date is on or before the date of processing.

validators.title: Seller distinct from buyer
validators.description: seller_name and buyer_name, normalised, are not identical.

validators.title: Required fields attempted
validators.description: Every profile-required field_path has an entry in the envelope (any status, including 'missing').

validators.title: Evidence integrity
validators.description: Every extracted field has at least one verified-anchor evidence quote.
